content: {"episode_id":"ep-05267","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings during daily activities."}
